37:107.text: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

37:110.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

37:112.text: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.

37:114.text: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

37:115.text: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

37:116.text: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

37:117.text: And We gave them the explicit Scripture

37:118.text: And We guided them on the straight path.

37:121.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

37:122.text: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.

37:123.text: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,

37:124.text: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?

37:126.text: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
